cover_headline: Who Is Vivek Ramaswamy? The Cincinnati-Born Biotech Billionaire Who Ran for President — and Is Now Two Days From a Bid to Become Ohio's First Indian-American Governor

end.headline: Who Is Vivek Ramaswamy? The Cincinnati-Born Biotech Billionaire Who Ran for President — and Is Now Two Days From a Bid to Become Ohio's First Indian-American Governor
end.line: His parents came from Palakkad, Kerala — an engineer and a psychiatrist who raised a Hindu valedictorian in Cincinnati.

facts: Vivek Ramaswamy, 41, the Cincinnati-born son of immigrants from Palakkad, Kerala, is the Republican nominee for governor of Ohio
A Suffolk University poll of 500 likely voters conducted October 21-26 put Acton at 48% and Ramaswamy at 44%
A win would make him Ohio's first Indian-American governor and the first Hindu governor in the United States

quote.text: And I say this as the proud son of legal immigrants to this country: your first act of entering this country cannot break the law.
